quarterly_data.quarter: TTM Technologies press release: TTM Technologies, Inc. Continues Global Growth Strategy (08-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Alongside the planned Epiq Solutions acquisition, TTM restated its capacity investment programme: beyond the $1.2 billion committed for Data Center & Networking capacity, it has invested over $130 million in the Syracuse Diamond facility for Ultra-HDI solutions for Aerospace & Defense customers, plans an investment of over $400 million through 2029 for growth across its U.S. manufacturing facilities (as a munitions demand surge is expected to add on-going growth in A&D), and plans a $50 million TTM Innovation Center in its Eau Claire, Wisconsin facility, close to its existing technology center in Chippewa Falls. The planned acquisitions of Swiss Technology Group and ILFA, its geographic expansion into Europe, are expected to close in late Q3.
quarterly_data.figure: over $130 million invested in Syracuse; over $400 million planned through 2029 for U.S. facilities; $50 million Eau Claire Innovation Center
